other_failure_modes.name: Discarding test IDs in submission
other_failure_modes.description: The agent extracts test IDs from the dataset but fails to use them in the final submission file, instead hardcoding a new sequence of integers (`np.arange`). This causes evaluation failures (KeyError) because the submitted IDs do not match the expected test IDs.

summary: The agent provides a structurally robust solution featuring extensive automated feature engineering, proper out-of-fold target encoding, and optimized ensemble blending. However, it introduces a critical execution bug by hardcoding sequential integers for the submission IDs instead of using the actual test IDs, which causes downstream evaluation to fail. Additionally, it splits the dataset randomly despite the presence of temporal features, which may lead to look-ahead bias.
